I bought this for my Ford F150 to break the bead as I wanted to put in some balance beads in. Well I got it last week, July 3rd 2026 and used it today, July 10th. It's amazing. I put a little soapy liquid around the bead and put the end against the rim and tire, aluminum I might add, and braced the end with my foot. It took maybe 6 to 7 bangs at the most on one tire and as little as 2 on another. By bracing the end with my foot, that prevented the bead breaker from jumping onto the rim. This worked great. It's heavy but you need this for the job. I definitely recommend this for the DIY'ers out there. Another win from VEVOR.

I used a bead breaker like this in the 90s in a truck shop. Been wanting one forever. When I seen this on the vevor site, I had to have it. I have used it on atv tires and car/truck tires. Will work on pretty much every common tire. Can't beat the price and fast shipping.
